focus: Skill and Project split: CLI-only skill route order, mirror pairs measured by cmp, router contract, differential host states, rule parity, twin divergence and the Sync Loop declaration
keyQuestions: How can the skill rely on the CLI alone while the Claude Project stays on MCP and the mirrored reference pairs stay byte-identical?
answeredQuestions: How can the skill rely on the CLI alone while the Claude Project stays on MCP and the mirrored reference pairs stay byte-identical?

label: The skill is still MCP-first because 005 has not started: SKILL.md:77 states the tools-first order, 101 makes the tool check call media_health, 257 says the skill drives the tools first, and references/cli.md does not exist. The target state is written in 005-skill-cli-only/spec.md:49-52.

All seven declared mirror pairs are byte-identical as of this reading (cmp -s on each): image-operations, video-and-audio-operations, hls-video-conversion, tools, setup, interactive-intelligence and media-framework. Pairs declared at systems.py:1252-1267 with router-contract.md as the declared unmirrored exception at 1271-1276.
sources: AI Systems/z - Claude Project Sync Loop/systems.py:1252-1276

label: choose_route is still tools-first at router-contract.md:147-155 and the kernel copy at systems.py:1680 carries the same body. The design adds media_cli_available() as the first branch and binds it False in the Project host so the kernel copy stays byte-identical modulo comments.
sources: AI Systems/z - Claude Project Sync Loop/systems.py:1680

label: differential.py:100-104 holds three host states on a two-boolean tuple, bind_host at 314-317 writes two predicates and 322 unpacks two booleans, so the change is a third boolean, a cli available state and a third binding. No schema change follows because route is not a contract field (route_contract.py:87-90, 236-238).

rule_parity.py:71-95 carries the route rule the tool check gates every operation tools first as five verbatim tools-first sentences with min_pairs 5, and its comment explains the five-phrase design. A CLI-first rewrite must place the new sentences in paired files and raise min_pairs in the same change.

twin_divergence.py:89-97 still pairs SRO-001 with PRO-001 as tools connected in Claude Code and Claude Desktop, but after the split the transports differ on purpose, so the pair should assert the deliverable while the route assertion moves to the unpaired sets, which already list SED-004 and PED-001 at 101-105.

The two new batch-naming-gate scenarios exist from phase 003 (skill-export-delivery/batch-naming-gate.md and project-export-delivery/batch-naming-gate.md) and twin_divergence.py lists them as SED-004 and PED-001 in the unpaired sets, awaiting grading in phase 006 per the 003 implementation summary.

The Sync Loop declaration needs three edits: references/cli.md joins unmirrored_sources at systems.py:1271-1276, the header residency statement at 1290 (The CLI sk-media-editor/ package and the Claude Code plugin run the same tools from a terminal) is wrong twice and needs a rewrite, and the router code statement at 1680 changes with choose_route and moves its statement key.
